_description: PLUGIN REGISTRY — single source of truth for my-browser (qute)'s plugin system. qutebrowser has no native plugin API/UI; a 'plugin' here is one of three surfaces: config (a qutebrowser setting, runtime-toggleable via :config-cycle, ZERO footprint when off), userscript (spawn --userscript / greasemonkey, only runs when invoked), or daemon (external system daemon, browser-agnostic). The home-module reads this file and generates: the `plugins` alias (opens the manager page), the `plugins-vaultwarden` alias, per-config-plugin `plugin-toggle-<id>` aliases (:config-cycle), keybindings, and the applied default settings for enabled config plugins. gen-dashboard.sh renders one card per plugin in the dashboard's Plugins tab. Toggle live from :plugins, its keybinding, or `:plugin-toggle-<id>` — no rebuild needed for config plugins. See PLAN_plugins-vaultwarden.md.

plugins.name: Ad & Tracker Blocking
plugins.description: EasyList + EasyPrivacy + StevenBlack hosts (lists in qute-settings.json). Blocks ads and trackers network-wide.
plugins.footprint: none when off — pure network filter

plugins.name: JavaScript
plugins.description: Global JS on/off. Off = maximum privacy/minimal footprint but breaks most sites; use per-site overrides for exceptions.

plugins.name: Dark Mode (all sites)
plugins.description: QtWebEngine's native page darkening for every site (independent of site theme). Off by default; toggle per taste.

plugins.name: Anti-Fingerprint (canvas)
plugins.description: Blocks canvas read-back, a major browser-fingerprinting vector. Enabled (protected) = canvas_reading disabled. Rarely breaks sites.

plugins.name: Block Autoplay
plugins.description: Stops media autoplaying. Enabled (blocked) = content.autoplay off.

plugins.name: Vaultwarden Autofill

actions._planned_card: Phase 1: fill credit card fields (bw item type 3)
actions._planned_identity: Phase 1: fill address/identity fields (bw item type 4)
actions._planned_save: Phase 1: :vault-save — save current login to the vault

plugins.description: In-page autofill against self-hosted vault.diegonmarcos.com via the official qute-bitwarden userscript + bw CLI (keyctl session, auto-lock). Login user/pass/TOTP today; cards, identities, save/edit/add land in Phase 1. One-time setup: run `bw login` once.

plugins.name: System Autofill (rofi)
plugins.description: OS-level password autofill (rbw + rofi → keystroke synth). Works in ANY window, not just the browser. Complements the in-page Vaultwarden plugin.
plugins.footprint: none until invoked — a systemd user service

plugins.name: FIDO2 Passkeys / WebAuthn
plugins.description: Passkeys / WebAuthn over a virtual FIDO2 device (/dev/uhid). QtWebEngine discovers it automatically on any WebAuthn prompt — zero browser config, no in-page UI needed.

plugins.name: Reader Mode
plugins.description: Strip a page to its article via readability-lxml (already in qute's python env). Planned Phase 2.

plugins.name: Video Tools (speed / PiP / download)
plugins.description: Playback speed ±, picture-in-picture, download via yt-dlp. Planned Phase 2.

plugins.name: Translate Selection
plugins.description: Send the current selection to a translate endpoint. Planned Phase 2.
